# CCMAF Skills — Windows System Care (`ccmaf-skills-system`)

Looking after a Windows PC: day-to-day administration, plain-language crash and slowdown diagnostics, security hygiene with reversible quarantine, measured performance tuning, and the machine's setup captured as code.

**Audience:** Anyone looking after a Windows PC — their own or the household's.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add drushegh/CCMAF---Skills
/plugin install ccmaf-skills-system@ccmaf-skills
```

Install `ccmaf-skills-core` alongside this pack.
